answer.en: Our range includes children’s thermal and base-layer sets, school clothing, teen and girls’ knitwear, long-sleeve and quick-dry T-shirts, and gift apparel. The online catalogue currently presents four thermal sets with detailed fabric and fit information.

question.en: Do you offer OEM / ODM and custom options?

answer.en: Yes. We support private-label OEM and ODM style development, including sizes, fabrics, fit, colours, prints, binding and sewing construction. Send your design or reference garment to discuss the details.

question.en: Who are your garments made for?

answer.en: We work with childrenswear brands, school-uniform buyers, maternity and baby wholesalers, cross-border sellers, and gift supply chains. Uses include next-to-skin layers, everyday homewear, schoolwear, and sports or leisure clothing.

question.en: Can you supply samples, and what do they cost?

answer.en: Stock samples and custom development samples are available. Stock samples carry a sample fee; custom samples carry a development fee. Samples can be shipped, with shipping paid by the customer. Ask for the fees for your selected style.
Stock samples usually take about 1–3 days; custom samples usually take about 5–7 days. Confirm the schedule for your fabric and design when ordering.

question.en: Do I approve a sample before bulk production?

answer.en: Yes. Custom orders proceed to bulk production after you approve the sample. Bulk garments follow the approved sample’s fabric, workmanship and agreed specifications.

question.en: What is the minimum order quantity?

answer.en: Contact us with your style, size range, fabric and estimated quantity so we can confirm the order requirements. Small trial orders can be discussed.

question.en: Do you offer volume and repeat-order pricing?

answer.en: Yes. Unit pricing decreases with larger order quantities, and repeat bulk orders from long-term customers can receive cooperation discounts. Significant fabric-cost or exchange-rate changes may affect pricing; we notify customers in advance.

question.en: What is included in the quotation?

answer.en: Basic packaging is included. Shipping and taxes are excluded. Confirm any special packaging or delivery requirements in your RFQ.

question.en: What is the usual production lead time?

answer.en: Regular orders usually take 7–15 days, adjusted for order quantity and construction complexity. Peak-season demand can extend the schedule; timing is discussed with you in advance. Expedited production may be available when capacity allows.

question.en: Can I receive production progress updates?

answer.en: Yes. We can share updates on cutting, sewing and final inspection as your order progresses.

question.en: What inspections do you carry out?

answer.en: Checks cover incoming fabrics, cutting and sewing, finished garments and packing. We inspect garments before dispatch and support third-party inspection. Please discuss the inspection arrangements with us before production.

question.en: Are technical data sheets or test reports available?

answer.en: No standard technical data sheets or test reports are currently available. Product pages list the available specifications, and you can review a sample before placing an order.

question.en: What should I include in an RFQ?

answer.en: Include your company, business email, product or reference design, size range, fabric and other custom requirements. Estimated quantity, target market and desired schedule help us prepare a relevant reply.

question.en: How can I contact the team?

answer.en: Use the RFQ form, email info@xiongbafushi.com, or call 17205771033. Our address is 1/F, Building 2, No. 80 Xinghua Street, Yishan Town, Cangnan County, Wenzhou, Zhejiang, China.
